The scientist incubated three lipase solutions for one hour at three different storage

catalyse the digestion of a small volume of oil. The values were then compared to the results
obtained at the optimum temperature for lipase (37 °C). Relative enzyme activity values
were determined.
The graph shows the mean results of the investigation.
